scripts.text:
[Keedz]
I don't allow any living person
to come in this place!
scripts.translation:
[基德兹]
我不允许任何活人
进入这个地方！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's up?

[Gigantia]
Just...
Come over here.
I have something
I must do for you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
只是...
过来一下。
我有必须为你
做的事情。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Your horn is crooked.
Always make sure your horn
is worn straight and neat.
The Lord of Death is always
looking at you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
你的角歪了。
一定要确保你的角
戴得端正整洁。
死神一直在
注视着你。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
The Lord of Death knows
and sees all. It's useless
to hide, and escape from
Death's sweet embrace.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
死神洞悉
并看见一切。想要躲避
并逃离死神甜美的
怀抱是徒劳的。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Hey, wait!
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
嘿，等等！

scripts.text:
[Undead Chicken]
I lived a peaceful life as a normal chicken. But then came the day I was tragically killed and eaten by humans. Well... Heh heh~! Now it's my turn! *Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死鸡]
我曾作为一只普通的小鸡过着平静的生活。但后来，我悲惨地被人类杀害并吃掉的那天来了。呵呵……嘿嘿～！现在轮到我了！*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch...!
A chicken...
It bit me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎哟……！
一只小鸡...
它咬了我！

scripts.text:
[Undead Chicken]
Ho ho~!
I can talk AND feast
on living humans!
Being a zombie is great!
*Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死鸡]
呵呵～！
我不仅能说话，还能
享用活人！
当僵尸的感觉真棒！
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Oooh, how handy, a living
human~! Fresh blood is
always tasty...! I think I'll just
take a liiittle sip.
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
噢，真方便，一个活人～！
新鲜的血液
总是很美味……！我想我只要
稍微吸一小口就好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow! My vein!
Did you just
suck my blood?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗷！我的血管！
你刚才是不是
在吸我的血？！

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Mwahahaha~
Foolish mortal!
Beware my powers!
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
姆哈哈哈哈～
愚蠢的凡人！
小心我的力量！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Where...where am I...?
I remember I was sleeping
and when I woke up, I was here...
Mommy, have you seen my mommy?
I wanna go home...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
我……我在哪里……？
我记得我当时在睡觉，
醒来时就在这里了……
妈妈，你看到我的妈妈了吗？
我想回家……*呜咽*

scripts.text: About the witch
scripts.translation: 关于女巫

scripts.text: About the curse
scripts.translation: 关于诅咒

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Witch...? I've never seen a witch, but I've read about them in books. I'm not sure if they exist or not, but it would be so horrifying if they did...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
女巫……？我从未见过女巫，但我曾在书里读到过她们。我不确定她们是否真的存在，但如果她们真的存在，那就太可怕了……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why is it so cold in here...?
A-aren't you cold, or even scared? I wanna go home... It's warm over there. Could you help me get back... Please...? H-help me...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
为什么这里这么冷……？
你……你不觉得冷，或者害怕吗？我想回家……那边很暖和。你能帮我回去吗……求你了……帮帮我……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
A c-curse...?
My grandma says that there are lots of curses in the world. Some of them, you can tell it's a curse. But there are other curses that follow you throughout life...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
诅……诅咒……？
老奶奶说世界上有很多诅咒。有些诅咒一眼就能看出来。但还有些诅咒会伴随你一生……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Grandma says curses can take other forms... Like if someone's always mad at you, and won't forgive you, you can see that as a curse too.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
老奶奶说诅咒可以有其他形式……比如如果有人总是对你发火，并且不原谅你，你也可以把那看作是一种诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
My grandma told me there's only one spell that can break a strong curse that you can't lift with Blessings...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
老奶奶告诉我，只有一种咒语可以打破那种连祝福都无法解除的强大诅咒……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Klaatu...
Verata.....
Ne...ni...umm...?
What was the last part?
I-I can't remember
the last part of the spell!
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
Klaatu...
Verata.....
Ne...ni...umm...?
最后一部分是什么来着？
我、我记不起
咒语的最后一部分了！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
If you repeat the spell in that order, it will release you from someone's anger and hate. And if you do it near a bad spirit, they might get the curse instead.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
如果你按那个顺序重复咒语，就能让你从他人的愤怒与恨意中解脱出来。如果你在邪灵附近这样做，咒语反而可能会降临在它们身上。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why are you asking me about these scary kind of things...? I just wanna go home...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
为什么要问我这些恐怖的事情……？我只想回家……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
It's so cold in here...
I'm freezing...
And I wanna go home and
get away from this scary place...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
这里好冷……
我快冻僵了……
我想回家，
离开这个可怕的地方……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Please... help me.
Could you take me with you...?
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
求求你……帮帮我。
能带我一起走吗……？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I sense you're cursed
by a powerful spell...
Hmm... It's clear what
you must be up to....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我感觉到你被
强大的咒语诅咒了……
唔……我很清楚
你到底在打什么主意……

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You wish to get
rid of your curse....
By giving it to me!!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你想摆脱
你的诅咒……
通过把它转嫁给我！！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Just because I'm a cursed spirit, you adventurers think you can just dump your curses on me?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
就因为我是个被诅咒的灵魂，你们这些冒险者就觉得可以随随便便把诅咒丢给我吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I refuse to let
you remain here.....
Leave now, or I will
remove you by force....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我拒绝让你
留在这里……
立刻离开，否则我会
强行把你赶走……

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....And...
....Whatever you do...
....Do NOT touch my books...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
……还有……
……无论你做什么……
……千万不要碰我的书……

scripts.text: Touch the first book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第一本书

scripts.text: Touch the second book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第二本书

scripts.text: Touch the third book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第三本书

scripts.text: Okay, I am leaving.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我这就走。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
How dare you touch my books
when I specifically said
'Don't touch my books!'
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
……！……
我明明特意说了
“不要碰我的书”！
你竟敢碰我的书！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....!...Grrrrr!
I shall tear you apart...!
Be bound by an eternal curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
……！……呃啊啊啊！
我要把你撕成碎片……！
承受永恒的诅咒吧……！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
You dare touch my books?!
Right after I said not
to touch them...?!
Foolish mortal!
...BEGONE!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
……！……
你竟敢碰我的书？！
就在我刚说完
不要碰它们之后……？！
愚蠢的凡人！
……滚开！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahaha....
Stubborn mortal~!
Fine! I will give you
a fighting chance and let
you cast a spell.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
唔哈哈哈哈……
顽固的凡人~！
好吧！我会给你
一个战斗的机会，
让你施展咒语。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
But Blessings won't
work with the curse
that you have...
And the spell to lift
your curse has been
lost to the ages~!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
但是祝福术对你
身上的诅咒
是没用的……
而且解除你诅咒的
咒语早已
失传在时光之中了~！

scripts.text: Clover
scripts.translation: 幸运草

scripts.text: Klaatu
scripts.translation: Klaatu

scripts.text: Klaytos
scripts.translation: Klaytos

scripts.text: Verit
scripts.translation: 毕莱特

scripts.text: Veritas
scripts.translation: Veritas

scripts.text: Verata
scripts.translation: Verata

scripts.text: Necktie
scripts.translation: 领带

scripts.text: Necklace
scripts.translation: 项链

scripts.text: Nero
scripts.translation: Nero

scripts.text: ^FFFFFFNictu!!!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFFNictu!!!^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
How did you know that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你...你解开了诅咒！
你是怎么知道那个咒语的？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我想你现在正等着看我
痛苦地融化吧，对吗？
呵呵... 抱歉让你失望了，凡人，
我是不会死的！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...! 你施放了正确的咒语？！
...!...
但是...你依然身负诅咒...
唔哈啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊.....!

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
What's...
this feeling?
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
这...
是什么感觉？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
No...!
NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
不...!
不啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Why did your spell have to work?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
为什么你的咒语会奏效？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You...
cast the correct spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你...
施放了正确的咒语？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Hoho~
But you're still cursed...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
呵呵~
但你依然身负诅咒...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
Who taught you that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你...你解开了诅咒！
是谁教你的那个咒语？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我想你现在正等着看我
痛苦地融化吧，对吗？
呵呵... 抱歉让你失望了，凡人，
我是不会死的！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
So long as I'm...
still...
cursed.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
只要我...
依然...
身负诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
NOOOOOOOOOO!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
不啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...! 你施放了正确的咒语？！
...!...
但是...你依然身负诅咒...
唔哈啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊.....!

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Mwahahahaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...！你施放了正确的咒语？！
...！...
但是...你依然身中诅咒...
姆哇哈哈哈哈.....！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahahahaha!
That's not the right spell!
Now, death awaits you!
You're eternally bound
to the curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
姆哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！
那根本不是正确的咒语！
现在，死亡在等着你！
你将永远被
诅咒所束缚...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...
.....

[Ashe Bruce]
Well then.
Try not to trip on
your feet in your
rush to leave.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
那么。
在急着离开的时候
可别被自己的脚
绊倒了。
